title: core.destruct — fracture sets, thresholds, debris mapping
description: How this entity comes apart. A fracture SET is one precomputed way of breaking, with its own pieces and its own trigger threshold; an entity may carry several (a gentle split, a violent shatter) and a runtime picks by impact energy. The piece geometry travels as GLB nodes; this file is the map from energy to pieces to sounds. Everything here is 'enhances': an entity with an unreadable destruct node is simply indestructible.

trigger.description: When this set fires. Energy in joules, because joules are what a physics engine already has and a 'strength 0..1' would not survive contact with any real simulation.

max_impact_energy_j.description: Upper bound of this set's band; the next, more violent set starts here. Omit on the most violent set.

directional.description: True when the set only applies to impacts within cone_half_angle_rad of axis.

axis.description: Model-space unit vector, required when directional is true.

geometry_node.description: node_id of the GLB holding every piece of this set, one mesh per piece, named by piece_id.

mesh_name.description: Exact node name inside geometry_node's GLB. A name, not an index (law 4).

part_id.description: Which original part this piece came from.

debris_class.description: Drives which debris sound and particle set a runtime picks.

audio_effect_id.description: Slug of the core.audio effect this piece plays when it first lands.

neighbors.description: piece_ids sharing a fracture face with this one. Lets a runtime break partially: sever only the bonds the impact reached.

bond_strength_n.description: Force in newtons needed to sever each bond, parallel to 'neighbors' and the same length. A validator MUST check the lengths match.

residue.description: What stays behind: the stump, the frame, the hole.

break_effect_id.description: The one-shot played at the moment of breaking.

settle_effect_id.description: The tail as pieces come to rest.

mass_check.description: Measured conservation: the pieces plus residue should weigh what the whole did.

relative_error.description: |sum - body| / body. A conformant enrichment pipeline keeps this below 0.02.
